aboutH2: GreeneStone Centre for Recovery: Private Detox and Residential Treatment in Bala, Muskoka
intro: GreeneStone Centre for Recovery is a private residential addiction treatment centre in Bala, in the Muskoka Lakes area about two hours north of Toronto. It sits on more than 40 acres beside Lake Muskoka and is part of Canadian Addiction Treatment Centres, which the centre names as its parent company. Its detox and addiction treatment programs are both CARF accredited.

Every stay starts in the medical wing, where clients detox or stabilize in a private room before they join the wider community. The core inpatient program runs 42 days, and some people stay 60 or 90. It treats alcohol and drug addiction along with conditions that often come with it, such as depression, anxiety, trauma and PTSD. Clients must be 18 or older.

pillars.title: Private Environment and Outdoor Activities
pillars.body: GreeneStone Centre for Recovery is located on a private, 40-acre property that offers a safe and peaceful environment for clients seeking recovery. The serene setting provides a space for relaxation, reflection, and healing. Clients have access to the beautiful lake, where they can enjoy canoeing, fishing, and other water activities. The property also offers various outdoor activities such as hiking, nature walks, and bonfires, providing clients with a healthy outlet for physical exercise and social interaction.

pillars.title: Medical Detoxification and Residential Treatment
pillars.body: The medical detoxification program at GreeneStone Centre for Recovery is designed to help clients safely and comfortably manage the uncomfortable symptoms of withdrawal. The program provides medically assisted treatment with medication and nursing care to help ease the symptoms. Residential treatment at GreeneStone involves staying at the facility 24/7, with a focus on individual and group therapy, meeting and connecting with peers, and developing self-care skills. Clients in residential treatment are given a structured daily routine, which includes therapy groups, one on one sessions, and wellness activities.

pillars.title: Second Stage Recovery Program
pillars.body: The Second Stage Recovery Program at GreeneStone Centre for Recovery offers a comprehensive treatment plan to clients who have completed residential treatment. The program provides a comfortable, home-like setting for clients and includes both group and individual therapy to promote continued recovery. Clients receive 24/7 support and guidance from staff and peers, along with access to various wellness activities and workshops. The second-stage program’s goal is to provide clients with a safe and supportive environment to help them transition back into everyday life while maintaining sobriety.

overview: GreeneStone Centre for Recovery is a private addiction treatment facility located in Ontario that specializes in helping individuals overcome addiction and alcoholism. The experienced team at GreeneStone collaborates with each client to develop an individualized treatment plan that targets their specific needs and goals. The Centre’s CARF accreditation attests to the high standard of care provided, and clients can expect a supportive and nurturing environment conducive to healing and sustained recovery.

location.heading: GreeneStone Centre for Recovery in Bala, Ontario
location.intro: GreeneStone is on Muskoka District Road 169 just outside Bala, in the Township of Muskoka Lakes, with Lake Muskoka beside the property. Toronto is about two hours south by Highway 400, Barrie is roughly an hour and a quarter, and Gravenhurst, Bracebridge and Port Carling are each 15 to 30 minutes away by car.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.a: GreeneStone does not publish its prices. The centre says cost depends on whether you choose a private or semi-private room and on the level of care you need, and its intake team gives fees over the phone at 1-855-821-5010. If you need more than 24 hours to stabilize before the core program, a daily stabilization fee is added.

faqs.q: How long is the program at GreeneStone?
faqs.a: The core inpatient program is 42 days, and GreeneStone recommends that clients stay at least that long. Stays of 60 and 90 days are also available, and the team suggests a length based on your substance use and mental health history. Clients who finish can move into the centre's continuing care programs.

Yes. Every client starts in the medical wing for at least 24 hours, or until detox is finished, in a private room with a queen bed and private bathroom. A nurse is on duty around the clock, and physicians and nurse practitioners can prescribe medication for withdrawal and cravings. Detox is offered for alcohol, benzodiazepines, opiates and other substances, and you can book it on its own without the inpatient program.

faqs.q: Where is GreeneStone and how do I get there?
faqs.a: GreeneStone is at 3571 Muskoka District Road 169 in Bala, in the Muskoka Lakes area of Ontario, about two hours north of Toronto. Gravenhurst and Bracebridge are each under half an hour away. The centre can arrange transportation help if getting there is hard, so ask the intake team when you call.

faqs.q: What happens after I leave GreeneStone?
faqs.a: Every client is offered the centre's aftercare program, with sessions with a continuing care provider, access to its therapy groups and a place in the alumni program. There are also paid virtual packages, including 4 or 6 week day and evening programs and 10 week DBT and PTSD programs. Alumni meet several times a week, and graduates can become ambassadors who support people just out of treatment.

faqs.q: What is the age range of clients accepted at GreeneStone Centre for Recovery?
faqs.a: GreeneStone Centre for Recovery accepts clients aged 18 and over.

faqs.q: What types of therapy are provided at GreeneStone Centre for Recovery?
faqs.a: GreeneStone Centre for Recovery provides various therapies, including cognitive-behavioral therapy, dialectical-behavioral therapy, eye movement therapy, and trauma-informed therapy.

faqs.q: Does GreeneStone Centre for Recovery provide aftercare support?
faqs.a: Yes, GreeneStone Centre for Recovery provides aftercare support for its clients.

faqs.q: Are family members allowed to visit clients at GreeneStone Centre for Recovery?
faqs.a: Yes, family members are allowed to visit clients at certain times during the program.

faqs.q: Does GreeneStone Centre for Recovery accept insurance?
faqs.a: Yes, GreeneStone Centre for Recovery accepts most major insurance plans.

faqs.q: Is GreeneStone private? Can I use my benefits?
faqs.a: Yes, GreeneStone is a private, fee-based centre. Depending on your plan and province, extended health benefits may cover some or all of the cost. Clients usually pay upfront and then send their receipts to the insurer, and the centre provides the paperwork you need.

GreeneStone Centre for Recovery is part of Canadian Addiction Treatment Centres, which the centre's website names as its parent company. The centre has run in Bala for more than a decade, and its detox and treatment programs are CARF accredited.
